content.title: Did Team USA baseball win tonight? WBC score vs. Dominican Republic
content.text: Below the photo gallery, the Times Union is providing updates before, during and after tonight’s game.Gunnar Henderson #11 of Team USA rounds the bases after hitting a solo home run in the fourth inning during the 2026 World Baseball Classic WBC game presented by Capital One between Team USA and Team Dominican Republic at loanDepot park on Sunday, March 15, 2026 in Miami, Florida. (Photo by Rob Tringali/WBCI/MLB Photos via Getty Images)Rob Tringali/MLB Photos via Getty Images Final: Team USA 2, Dominican Republic 1 11:10 p.m.: Geraldo Perdomo takes a controversial called third strike from Mason Miller as Team USA hangs on to beat the Dominican Republic 2-1.Article continues below this ad Tying run at third, two out 11 p.m.: The tying run is at third base with two outs in the bottom of the ninth. Tying run aboard for Dominican Republic 10:57 p.m.: Julio Rodriguez works a one-out walk to get the tying run on base for the Dominican Republic. Up next, pinch-hitter Oneil Cruz replaces Austin Wells.Article continues below this ad Team USA three outs away 10:53 p.m.: Mason Miller replaces Garrett Whitlock to start the bottom of the ninth, looking to close out the Dominican Republic and punch Team USA's ticket to the WBC final on Tuesday. End 8th: Team USA 2, Dominican Republic 1 10:43 p.m.: Garrett Whitlock strikes out Manny Machado to retire the Dominican Republic in order in the bottom of the eighth. We head to the top of the ninth. Will there be some late fireworks?Article continues below this ad Garrett Whitlock replaces David Bednar 10:35 p.m.: Team USA makes a pitching change as Garrett Whitlock replaces David Bednar to begin the bottom of the eighth inning. Whitlock will face Juan Soto, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. and Manny Machado. Byron Buxton replaces Roman Anthony in the outfield for Team USA. Kyle Schwarber walks 10:31 p.m.: Kyle Schwarber works a one-out walk and Ernie Clement comes on to pinch run as Team USA looks to add some cushion to its 2-1 lead here in the top of the eighth inning.Article continues below this ad End 7th: David Bednar does it again 10:25 p.m.: With the tying run at third base and go-ahead run at second, David Bednar strikes out Fernando Tatis Jr. and Ketel Marte to preserve Team USA's 2-1 lead as we head to the top of the eighth. Tying run aboard for Dominican Republic 10:17 p.m.: The tying run is aboard as Austin Wells doubles on a fly ball to right with one out in the bottom of the seventh inning. David Bednar on the mound for Team USA.Article continues below this ad Why is Austin Wells playing for the Dominican Republic? 10:13 p.m.: Dominican Republic's starting catcher Austin Wells was born in Arizona, but he is eligible to play for the Dominican team through his mother. End 6th: Team USA 2, Dominican Republic 1 10:10 p.m.: Griffin Jax comes into the game for Team USA and retires the side in order on just seven pitches as we quickly move to the top of the seventh.Article continues below this ad Huascar Brazobán strikes out the side 10:04 p.m.: Quite a performance by Huascar Brazobán, who strikes out Will Smith, Roman Anthony and Brice Turang on 12 pitches as we move to the bottom of the sixth inning. End 5th: Team USA 2, Dominican Republic 1 9:56 p.m.: Tyler Rogers gets Juan Soto to ground into a double play as Team USA escapes the fifth inning with its 2-1 lead intact. Article continues below this ad Paul Skenes exits 9:52 p.m.: Paul Skenes' night is done after back-to-back singles from Fernando Tatis Jr. and Ketel Marte put runners on first and second with one out in the bottom of the fifth inning. Tyler Rogers comes on in relief with Juan Soto coming up to bat. Who is Roman Anthony? 9:49 p.m.: One of Team USA’s home run hitters tonight, Roman Anthony, has Italian heritage through both parents and was recruited to play for Team Italy. Anthony is a promising 21-year-old outfielder for the Boston Red Sox who had a breakout 2025 season, during which he was a finalist for AL Rookie of the Year. He’s been a key contributor for Team USA in the WBC, batting .316 through five games.Article continues below this ad Julio Rodriguez robs Aaron Judge 9:37 p.m.: Julio Rodriguez with a defensive gem for the Dominican Republic, scaling the wall deep in center field to rob Aaron Judge of a home run for the second out in the top of the fifth inning. End 4th: Team USA 2, Dominican Republic 1 9:34 p.m.: Paul Skenes gets Austin Wells to fly out to left with the bases loaded, and Team USA clings to a 2-1 lead as we head to the top of the fifth inning.Article continues below this ad Julio Rodriguez hit by pitch 9:31 p.m.: Paul Skenes hits Julio Rodriguez with a pitch to load the bases for Austin Wells with two outs in the bottom of the fourth. Junior Caminero comes to the plate 9:27 p.m.: Junior Caminero comes to the plate with two on and one out and Team USA leading 2-1 in the bottom of the fourth. Caminero homered in his first at-bat.Article continues below this ad Team USA baseball merch 9:22 p.m.: Looking for Team USA baseball gear? Look no further. Luis Severino's line 9:18 p.m.: Dominican Republic starter Luis Severino went 3 1/3 innings, allowing one run on five hits and striking out six.Article continues below this ad Roman Anthony homers for Team USA 9:11 p.m.: Roman Anthony greets new Dominican Republic pitcher Gregory Soto with a homer to center, giving Team USA a 2-1 lead with one out in the top of the fourth. Gunnar Henderson ties it up 9:06 p.m.: Gunnar Henderson turns on a pitch from Luis Severino and drives it deep to right field to lead off the fourth inning with a solo shot, tying the game 1-1.Article continues below this ad End 3rd: Aaron Judge throws out Fernando Tatis 9 p.m.: Team USA captain Aaron Judge throws out Fernando Tatis Jr. at third base to end the third inning. Tatis was advancing from first base on a single to right off the bat of Ketel Marte. We head to the top of the fourth with Team USA trailing 1-0. Back-to-back K's for Luis Severino 8:51 p.m.: Luis Severino strikes out Kyle Schwarber looking to strand runners on second and third, and keep Team USA off the board. We head to the bottom of the third inning with the Dominican Republic leading 1-0. Six strikeouts in the game for Severino.Article continues below this ad Aaron Judge strikes out swinging 8:48 p.m.: Luis Severino records his fifth strikeout of the game, as Aaron Judge goes down swinging for the second out and runners on second and third. Team USA cooking up a rally 8:45 p.m.: Team USA is cooking up a rally with one out in the top of the third. Bobby Witt Jr. singled to left and Bryce Harper doubled to right, putting runners on second and third with Aaron Judge coming to the plate.Article continues below this ad End 2nd: Dominican Republic 1, Team USA 0 8:38 p.m.: Julio Rodriguez grounds out to second to end the inning but the Dominican Republic strikes first on Junior Caminero's solo home run. Junior Caminero homers 8:35 p.m.: Junior Caminero launches a solo homer to left field to give the Dominican Republic a 1-0 lead with two outs in the bottom of the second. Julio Rodriguez up next.Article continues below this ad Dominican Republic coming to bat 8:31 p.m.: Luis Severino works around a leadoff single by Will Smith, striking out Roman Anthony and inducing a double-play off the bat of Brice Turang. We go to the bottom of the second, still scoreless. End 1st: Team USA 0, Dominican Republic 0 8:24 p.m.: Paul Skenes retires the side in order, thanks to a diving play from second baseman Brice Turang to rob Juan Soto of a two-out hit, and we head to the top of the second inning.Article continues below this ad Severino escapes 1st 8:20 p.m.: Gunnar Henderson grounds out to second to end the top of the first inning as Luis Severino wriggles into and out of trouble. Aaron Judge scorches a single 8:15 p.m.: Aaron Judge scorches a two-out single to left field and Kyle Schwarber is hit by a pitch bringing up Gunnar Henderson with two on and two out in the top of the first.Article continues below this ad Luis Severino dealing 8:12 p.m.: Luis Severino strikes out Bobby Witt Jr. and Bryce Harper to bring up Aaron Judge with two outs. Team USA vs. Dominican Republic underway 8:10 p.m.: Luis Severino's first pitch to Bobby Witt Jr. is a ball and the game is underway in Miami.Article continues below this ad Gunnar Henderson in, Alex Bregman out 8:05 p.m.: One notable change to the Team USA lineup comes at third base, where Gunnar Henderson gets the start instead of Alex Bregman. USA vs. Dominican Republic 8 p.m.: This will be the fourth matchup between the U.S. and the Dominican Republic in the World Baseball Classic, but the first at this stage of the tournament.Article continues below this adIn 2013, the D.R. defeated the U.S. 3-1 in pool play, on the way to their lone tournament title. In 2017, the D.R. again won 7-5 in pool play, but the quarterfinal rematch featured a memorable moment when Adam Jones made a leaping catch, helping the U.S. secure a 6-3 victory and ultimately their only championship. Dominican Republic lineup 7:50 p.m.: Here's a look at the star-studded lineup for the Dominican Republic.1. Fernando Tatis Jr., RF2. Ketel Marte, 2B3. Juan Soto, LF4. Vladimir Guerrero Jr., 1B5. Manny Machado, 3B6. Junior Caminero, DH7. Julio Rodríguez, CF8. Austin Wells, C9. Geraldo Perdomo, SSArticle continues below this ad The Austin Wells effect 7:45 p.m.: Austin Wells is the starting catcher for the Dominican Republic and has emerged as a breakout star in the WBC. Born in Arizona, he is eligible to play for the Dominican team through his mother. Wells has hit two home runs in the tournament, including a crucial three-run walk-off homer in the seventh inning against South Korea, which ended the game via the 10-run "mercy rule" and secured the Dominican team a spot in the semifinals. Wells currently plays for the New York Yankees in the MLB, serving as their primary catcher. Paul Skenes and Livvy Dunne 7:30 p.m.: Team USA starting pitcher tonight, Paul Skenes, is in a high-profile relationship with Livvy Dunne, a former competitive gymnast at LSU. The power couple met as student-athletes at LSU in 2023 and have been dating since. Skenes is the reigning NL Cy Young Award winner and previously won the NL Rookie of the Year in 2024. Dunne reportedly has begun a professional acting career and recently joined the cast of the “Baywatch” reboot. The series is scheduled to premiere during the 2026-2027 TV season.Article continues below this ad Paul Skenes vs. Luis Severino
